$description: ResourceList (platform/patterns/ResourceList, library wave 8, lane C): its component tokens, the header, the groups and the rows. The checkboxes, pictures, headings and the command bar are Checkbox's, Thumbnail's, Avatar's, SectionHeading's and CommandBar's own.

resource-list-gap.$description: ResourceList: the space between the bar, the header and the groups.

resource-list-header-min-height.$description: ResourceList: the header's height (select all and the count), a data row's height (it follows the density).

resource-list-header-border-bottom-color.$description: ResourceList: the line under the header.

resource-list-count-text.$description: ResourceList: the count in the header and after a group's heading.

resource-list-group-gap.$description: ResourceList: the space between a group's heading and its rows.

resource-list-group-count-font-family.$description: ResourceList: a group's count (a technical value: Reddit Mono).

resource-list-group-count-margin-inline-.$description: ResourceList: the space between a group's heading and its count.

resource-list-item-gap.$description: ResourceList: the space between the checkbox, the picture, the text, the details and the actions.

resource-list-item-min-height.$description: ResourceList: a row's least height (a data row's: it follows the density).

resource-list-item-padding-block.$description: ResourceList: the space above and under a row's content.

resource-list-item-interactive-margin-in.$description: ResourceList: a row that opens reaches past the list's edges by its inset, so only its fill does.

resource-list-item-interactive-padding-i.$description: ResourceList: the inset of a row that opens (room for its fill).

resource-list-item-hover-background.$description: ResourceList: a row under the pointer.

resource-list-item-selected-background.$description: ResourceList: a selected row (its checkbox is checked too: never color alone).

resource-list-item-focus-outline-color.$description: ResourceList: the focus ring around a row whose name has keyboard focus.

resource-list-item-focus-outline-offset.$description: ResourceList: the focus ring sits inside the row.

resource-list-control-z-index.$description: ResourceList: the checkbox and the actions sit above the name's target, which covers the row.

resource-list-description-text.$description: ResourceList: the line about the record.

resource-list-meta-text.$description: ResourceList: the details at the row's end.

resource-list-actions-gap.$description: ResourceList: the space between the details and between the actions.
